run_zeroshot_evaluation: run a zero-shot in-context learning evaluation on a GPT-2 model for a specified task
run_fewshot_evaluation: run a few-shot in-context learning evaluation with demonstrations on a GPT-2 model
run_calibration: run a calibrated evaluation that subtracts null bias losses from prediction losses
run_random_english_words: run an evaluation that replaces classification options with random English words
run_unseen_domain_test: run an evaluation restricted to unseen domain test datasets only
